metadata.description: netbrah's fork of speedread by Brennen Green (MIT), packaged for Cursor.

plugins.name: speedread-netbrah
plugins.description: Read, search and trace code within a token budget: the function around each hit, a big file's skeleton, a symbol's callers, or only what changed. Read-only, no index, no folder to configure. A fork of speedread by Brennen Green (MIT) with request deadlines and bounded memory.
